<?php
$value159Review = "7";
$replacement159Review = new class {
    public function __invoke($first, $second): string {
        echo "replacement-body|";
        return "replacement";
    }
};
$callable159Review = new class {
    public function __invoke(int &$value, $ignored): string {
        echo $value === 7 ? "head-int|" : "bad-head|";
        $value = 11;
        return "original";
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "original-dtor|"; }
};
$result159Review = $callable159Review($value159Review, $callable159Review = $replacement159Review);
echo $result159Review, "|", $value159Review, "|";
echo $callable159Review(1, 2), "|after";

<?php
function argument159Review() { echo "argument|"; return 9; }
$callable159Review = new class {
    public function __invoke($first, $last): int { echo "bad-body|"; return 0; }
};
echo "before|";
try {
    $callable159Review();
} catch (ArgumentCountError $error159Review) {
    echo $error159Review->getMessage(), "|", $error159Review->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $callable159Review(last: argument159Review());
} catch (ArgumentCountError $error159Review) {
    echo $error159Review->getMessage(), "|", $error159Review->getLine(), "|";
}
echo "after";

<?php
$slot159Author = "7";
$alias159Author =& $slot159Author;
$receiver159Author = new class {
    public $calls = 0;
    public function __invoke(int &$value, int $delta = 2): int {
        $this->calls++;
        $value += $delta;
        return $value;
    }
};
echo $receiver159Author($slot159Author), "|";
echo $slot159Author, "|", $slot159Author === 9 ? "int|" : "bad|";
echo $receiver159Author->__invoke($alias159Author, delta: 4), "|";
echo $slot159Author, "|", $receiver159Author->calls, "|after";

<?php
class Base159Author {
    public $offset = 10;
    public function __invoke(int $value): int {
        echo "base|";
        return $this->offset + $value;
    }
}
$receiver159Author = new class extends Base159Author {
    public function __invoke(int $value): int {
        echo "child|";
        return parent::__invoke($value) + 1;
    }
};
echo $receiver159Author(2), "|";
$receiver159Author->offset = 20;
echo $receiver159Author->__invoke(3), "|after";

<?php
$source159Author = 'namespace Method159Author;
function make159Author() {
    return new class {
        function __invoke(int $first = 3, int $last = 4): int {
            return $first * 10 + $last;
        }
    };
}';
eval($source159Author);
$first159Author = Method159Author\make159Author();
$second159Author = Method159Author\make159Author();
echo $first159Author(last: 8), "|";
echo $second159Author(), "|";
echo $first159Author(), "|";
echo $first159Author === $second159Author ? "bad|" : "distinct|";
echo "after";
